title: Evaluation under coordinate permutation
statement: Let $A$ be a set of available coordinates among the $n$ coordinates, let $\sigma$ be a permutation of those coordinates, and let $T$ be a finite decision tree with labels in $\alpha$ and available coordinates $A$. For any input $x$ assigning an alphabet symbol to each coordinate, evaluating the tree obtained by permuting $T$'s coordinates by $\sigma$ equals evaluating $T$ at the input $i\mapsto x(\sigma(i))$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite set A of available coordinates in Fin n
A permutation σ of Fin n
A finite decision tree over Ω with labels in α and available set A
An input x : Fin n → Ω
